sub_projects.title: Chloroquine Resistance Evolution via pfAAT1
sub_projects.data: 600 P. falciparum genomes, Gambia 1984-2014, NCBI SRA
sub_projects.notebook_seed: pfaat1_allele_trajectories.ipynb  reproduce Fig 1a allele frequency trajectories for S258L and K76T, selection coefficient estimation
sub_projects.connection_to_138: the digestive vacuole is a bounded compartment with two transporters competing  this IS the LAT1 competition at the molecular level. amino acid transporter (pfAAT1) vs drug transporter (pfCRT). Anderson localization in a malaria parasite.
sub_projects.onboard_value: anyone who runs this notebook learns: population genomics, selection scanning, allele frequency math. and they see the LAT1/BBB connection to Paper 138.

sub_projects.title: PTP Expression in Cancer Metastasis
sub_projects.notebook_seed: ptp_screen_colorectal.ipynb  screen ~100 PTPs in CRC vs normal tissue, differential expression, pathway enrichment
sub_projects.connection_to_138: phosphatase activity = the OFF switch for kinase signaling. JAK/STAT (Gonzales' Apoquel target) is regulated by PTPs. screening which PTPs are overexpressed in metastases is the COMPLEMENT of Gonzales' JAK inhibitor work.
sub_projects.onboard_value: RNA-seq pipeline, differential expression, pathway analysis. bridges to Gonzales/ADDRC drug discovery pipeline.

sub_projects.title: CAZyme Landscapes
sub_projects.notebook_seed: cazyme_diversity.ipynb  map CAZyme family diversity across microbial genomes, cluster by substrate specificity
sub_projects.connection_to_138: CAZymes break down complex carbohydrates in the gut. gut microbiome composition affects serotonin production (90% in gut). CAZyme diversity ? fiber metabolism ? short-chain fatty acid production ? vagal nerve signaling ? mood. the gut-brain axis runs through CAZymes.
sub_projects.onboard_value: genome annotation, enzyme family classification, ecological diversity metrics.

sub_projects.title: Salmon RNA-seq Pipeline
sub_projects.notebook_seed: salmon_quant_tutorial.ipynb  Salmon quasi-mapping, tximport, DESeq2 differential expression
sub_projects.connection_to_138: RNA-seq is how you MEASURE gene expression changes. to validate the serotonin/locust phase transition (LAB-004), you'd RNA-seq the thoracic ganglia before and after serotonin application. to validate the BBB LAT1 competition (LAB-002), you'd RNA-seq the endothelial cells after amino acid challenge. salmon is the tool.
sub_projects.onboard_value: the most broadly useful bioinformatics skill. everyone needs RNA-seq.
